subject: Port regexes-stage1.ts and regexes-stage2.ts
description:
## Task: Port regex pattern files to TypeScript

### Context
Read `scripts/slop-score/prompt.md` for full project context.

### Prerequisites
- Task #1 (project structure) must be complete

### What to do

#### Port regexes-stage1.ts
Create `scripts/slop-score/src/lib/regexes-stage1.ts` by porting from `js/regexes-stage1.js`:

```typescript
// Example structure - port actual patterns from source
export const STAGE1_PATTERNS: Record<string, RegExp> = {
  S1_not_just_but: /not just .+?, but/gi,
  // ... all other patterns from js/regexes-stage1.js
};
```

#### Port regexes-stage2.ts
Create `scripts/slop-score/src/lib/regexes-stage2.ts` by porting from `js/regexes-stage2.js`:

```typescript
// Example structure - port actual patterns from source
export const STAGE2_PATTERNS: Record<string, RegExp> = {
  // ... all patterns from js/regexes-stage2.js
};
```

### Notes
- These are direct ports - just add TypeScript types
- Ensure regex flags are preserved (g, i, etc.)
- Export as named constants
- No tests needed for static regex patterns

### Reference
- Source: `js/regexes-stage1.js`, `js/regexes-stage2.js`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/lib/regexes-stage1.ts` exists with all patterns from source
- [ ] `src/lib/regexes-stage2.ts` exists with all patterns from source
- [ ] Files compile without TypeScript errors
- [ ] All regex patterns are properly typed
- [ ] Exports match what contrast-detector.ts will need
